source: Thread dimensions restructured from FreeCAD CAM external-thread tables; all dimensions stored in mm.
notes: Loose classes are derived: Metric 8g from 6g using ISO 965-1 grade 8 = 1.6 x grade 6 rounded to R40 (pitch >= 0.8 mm); Imperial 1A from 2A using ASME B1.1 1A tolerances = 1.5 x 2A with the same allowance (1/4 in and larger).
selection: Common ISO coarse sizes and selected fine pitches; common Unified (UNC/UNF) imperial sizes only.
layout: standards -> sizes -> pitches (keyed by thread designation) -> fits (keyed by class) -> diameter ranges [min, max] in mm.
